verdict.rationale: Smithery is an MCP registry and connection platform, so a recurring-schedule capability is a fair question for it. The evidence documents no cron, scheduled job, or recurring workflow feature. Triggers (smithery-docs-12, smithery-docs-25) only proxy event subscriptions from upstream services, a different event-driven feature that is not a recurring schedule, and the hosted services have since shut down.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
